actions.name: AddCertificateToDomain
actions.description: Grants permission to add certificates for mutual TLS authentication to a domain name. This is an additional authorization control for managing the DomainName resource due to the sensitive nature of mTLS

actions.name: CreateAccessAssociation
actions.description: Grants permission to create an access association from an access association source to a custom domain name for private APIs

actions.name: DELETE
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a particular resource

actions.name: GET
actions.description: Grants permission to read a particular resource

actions.name: PATCH
actions.description: Grants permission to update a particular resource

actions.name: POST
actions.description: Grants permission to create a particular resource

actions.name: PUT
actions.description: Grants permission to update a particular resource

actions.name: RejectAccessAssociation
actions.description: Grants permission to reject an existing access association owned by another account to a custom domain name for private APIs

actions.name: RemoveCertificateFromDomain
actions.description: Grants permission to remove certificates for mutual TLS authentication from a domain name. This is an additional authorization control for managing the DomainName resource due to the sensitive nature of mTLS

actions.name: SetWebACL
actions.description: Grants permission to set a WAF access control list (ACL). This is an additional authorization control for managing the Stage resource due to the sensitive nature of WebAcl's

actions.name: UpdateDomainNameManagementPolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to update the management policy of a custom domain name for private APIs

actions.name: UpdateDomainNamePolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to update the invoke policy of a custom domain name for private APIs

actions.name: UpdateRestApiPolicy
actions.description: Grants permission to manage the IAM resource policy for an API. This is an additional authorization control for managing an API due to the sensitive nature of the resource policy
